# E0302: the lineage declares a lens its versions do not require

A lineage declares exactly the lenses its versions call for. A forward lens
across a minor version is one they do not: a minor version is backward
compatible, so translating forward is implicit. The note says why the lens is
not called for.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
	"0.0->0.1": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0302]: the lineage's versions do not call for lens 0.0->0.1
  --> lineage.cue:24:2
   |
24 |     "0.0->0.1": {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^
   |
   = note: 0.1 is backward compatible with 0.0, so translating forward is implicit
   = help: a lineage declares a lens from each schema back to its predecessor, and one forward across each major version
```
